row: Conveniently located on the north side of Fort Wayne, Indiana, Dupont Veterinary Clinic is committed to providing the best possible care for your dog, cat, bird or exotic animal in a caring, friendly atmosphere.  We are a vibrant, growing practice and we work hard to go the extra mile for you.  Unlike numerous veterinary clinics in Fort Wayne, our animal hospital is locally owned allowing us to provide more personal service. http://www.dupontvet.com.
